Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to feature a brand-new all-glass design, perfectly timed to coincide with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's launch. Today, a new leak has shed further light on Apple's progress with this innovative model.

Here is the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design.

We are only weeks away from the unveiling of Apple's first foldable model, the highly innovative iPhone Ultra. But next year will bring another entirely new iPhone design.

There are rumours that Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. The new device is reportedly set to feature a larger display, using a quad-curved screen where the display extends to the edges of the body, creating a visually bezel-less effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital reported in a new post today on Apple's progress in achieving this distinctive look.

He said Apple has used the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but with modifications, switching to more rounded materials.

The post also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Body thickness

It is still too early to know what specifications Apple is aiming for in terms of thickness and design materials. However, so far there are signs that this new device will draw inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not equally prioritise thinness as its top concern.

Based on these latest updates, it looks like we can expect to see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra in a model that still delivers the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users do not want thinness to be the priority, but if Apple can offer a similar user experience in a slightly thinner model, along with a unique all-glass exterior, it should be very appealing.

How interested are you in the rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model coming next year? Let us know in the comments section.
